data.reporting_model: For this explicitly finite-data reanalysis,use the unweighted least-squares degree 4 polynomial in u=(V-origin)/scale over all 11 supplied volumes for each requested free-energy curve. At each temperature minimize static electronic energy plus phonon Helmholtz free energy at zero pressure. For the static reference use only electronic energy. Do not add zero-point energy again:the archived phonon free energy already includes it. This polynomial reporting model is not the original Vinet equation-of-state algorithm.
data.derivative_convention: For each reporting center,use the central finite difference of equilibrium volume at T±20K divided by40K and by the equilibrium volume at the center to define volumetric beta. Compute the isothermal bulk-modulus surrogate as B=V*d²F/dV² at that same center. Linearly interpolate the actual source constant-volume heat capacity across V at the actual equilibrium volume. Define the effective thermodynamic Gruneisen indicator as beta*B*V/Cv in one consistent energy/cell basis;this is not a mode-resolved frequency Gruneisen parameter.
data.normalization: Electronic energies/volumes and every archived phonon property refer to the SAME 8-atom conventional Si cell. The original README explicitly says no primitive-axis reduction. A mole means a mole of those 8-atom cells for phonon free energy and Cv,not a mole of atoms. No electronic finite-temperature free-energy term is supplied.
data.scope: Authentic published computational example data reanalyzed with an explicitly prescribed finite-volume polynomial surrogate. No experimental lattice parameters,full anharmonic dynamics,source Vinet reproduction or mode-resolved Gruneisen values are claimed.
